_source_w_ms_per_plan_alias: 2026-10-22, expert ruling for option D: cd_ib0_inflightfull_fsaware (HEROSIM_PG_FAIRSHARE_AWARE=1) is charged the bar's frozen w_ms_per_plan of cd_ib0_inflightfull (moderate 0.0116, heavy 0.01098).
